title: A 2-day adventure weekend from Bengaluru
hook: Two days, one weekend, zero planning stress.
cta: Vote in Stories: surf, kayak or trek next?
caption: A weekend of kayaking, coracle rides and forest walks on the Cauvery, about 100 km from Bengaluru. Vote in Stories: surf, kayak or trek next?
altText: A 30-second reel laying out a two-day adventure weekend on the Cauvery near Bheemeshwari, about 100 km from Bengaluru: drive out, evening coracle ride and kayaking, then a guided nature walk on day two.

beats.voiceover: Leave Bengaluru in the morning. It is about 100 km down Kanakapura road, two to three hours depending on traffic.
Settle in, then an evening coracle ride and a kayak on the river.
Day two is a guided nature walk before the drive back.

beats.voiceover: Best months are October to March. Check current prices and availability before you go.

cover.title: 2 days on the Cauvery, 100 km from Bengaluru
cover.body: Coracle, kayak, forest walk. No planning needed.

facts.claim: Bheemeshwari is about 100 km from Bengaluru
facts.source: Karnataka Tourism; Jungle Lodges' own write-up gives about 90 km via Kanakapura road
facts.note: The script says 100 km and leaves the drive time as two to three hours depending on traffic, which no source states as a fixed number.

facts.claim: The best season there is October to March
facts.note: The plan said August to February; Karnataka Tourism says October to March, so the script now follows the tourism board.

facts.claim: Coracle rides, kayaking and guided nature walks run on this stretch of the Cauvery
facts.note: All three named on Jungle Lodges' own site. Still worth a call before the weekend in case something is paused.

facts.claim: A zipline operates in the area
facts.source: Karnataka Tourism lists zip-lining among the adventure activities
facts.note: Listed, but left out of the script: it is not on Jungle Lodges' own page and availability moves.

notes: No prices on screen: they change, and a wrong number is exactly what people screenshot. The script sends people to check instead, which is also more useful. Drive time is given as a range rather than a flat 2.5 hours, because no source states a time.

history.note: Script and cover from the Week 1 plan. Four facts still to check.
Distance, season and activities checked against Karnataka Tourism and Jungle Lodges; season corrected from August–February to October–March.
